MAPSHINE.ToolDescription: Open the Map Shine effects panel to configure visual enhancements.
MAPSHINE.PerformanceGraphicsDescription: Tune how Map Shine looks and runs on your device
MAPSHINE.PerformanceGraphicsMenuLead: These settings apply only to your browser and can help if the map feels slow or choppy.
MAPSHINE.PerformanceGraphicsMenuPreloadH: These defaults apply before a scene finishes loading — use them if WebGL crashes prevent the map from opening.
MAPSHINE.PerformanceGraphicsMenuOpenHint: Opens the full in-game panel (effects, FPS, per-scene overrides) once Map Shine has initialized.
MAPSHINE.ClientGpuVramPresetHint: Set your graphics card VRAM. Auto guesses from system RAM and often over-estimates (e.g. 16 GB RAM → 16 GB VRAM). Choose 8 GB if you have an 8 GB GPU.
MAPSHINE.ClientRenderResolutionPresetHin: Used when a scene has no saved override yet. Medium (1280×720) helps large maps on 8 GB GPUs.
MAPSHINE.NativeFoundryRenderingName: Use Native Foundry Rendering (Low GPU Mode)
MAPSHINE.NativeFoundryRenderingHint: Bypass Map Shine's Three.js renderer on this browser. Foundry's default PIXI canvas is used instead — no Map Shine effects, particles, or post-processing. Ideal for low-end GPUs or players who want to join without heavy animation. Reload the page after changing this.
MAPSHINE.NativeFoundryRenderingMenuHint: Bypass Map Shine on this browser and use Foundry's default PIXI canvas instead
MAPSHINE.NativeFoundryRenderingMenuLead: A safety option for players and GMs on weaker devices — or anyone who prefers Foundry's standard canvas.
MAPSHINE.NativeFoundryRenderingMenuBody: When enabled, Map Shine does not load its Three.js renderer, effects, or loading overlay on this browser. You can still join worlds and scenes that use Map Shine; you will see the map through Foundry's native PIXI pipeline instead.
MAPSHINE.NativeFoundryRenderingMenuBulle: No Map Shine water, weather, lighting FX, or post-processing on this client
Applies only to your browser — other players are unaffected
Turn off and reload to restore full Map Shine rendering
MAPSHINE.NativeFoundryRenderingStatusOn: Currently active on this browser — reload to apply if you just changed it.
MAPSHINE.NativeFoundryRenderingStatusOff: Map Shine rendering is active on this browser.
MAPSHINE.NativeFoundryRenderingReloadOn: Native Foundry rendering enabled. Reload the page to bypass Map Shine on this browser.
MAPSHINE.NativeFoundryRenderingReloadOff: Map Shine rendering will resume after you reload the page.
MAPSHINE.PlayerLightPickerSelectToken: Select a token on the canvas first
MAPSHINE.PlayerLightPickerNoModes: No player light modes are enabled for you on this scene.
